question: If 11 August 1918 is Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 4 December 1925?
solution:
Given : 11 August 1918 was Sunday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 11 August 1918 to 4 December 1925 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 1918
 11 August 1918 - 31 December 1918
 20 August + 30 September + 31 October + 30 November + 31 December = 142 days
 142 ÷ 7 = 2
 
 

 1919 - 1924
 Full years (4 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 4 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 2 Leap years) = 8 odd days
 8 ÷ 7 = 1
 
 

 1925
 1st January 1925 - 4 December 1925
 365 days - 27 days = 338 days
 338 ÷ 7 = 2
